name: Mir-Sputnik
evidence: Mir (and the adjacent Sputnik) kimberlite pipe is at the town of Mirny, Sakha Republic (about 62.53N 113.99E). The reported point is ~1,250 km NE in the Yana-Indigirka lowland, far from any kimberlite field; Udachnaya in the same source is correctly placed in the same Daldyn-Alakit/Malo-Botuobiya kimberlite province. Relocated to the Mir pipe; 0.5-degree precision.

name: Kivu (Goma Kivu)
evidence: Record is labelled Congo (Kinshasa), Kivu, with Sn-W-Au-Nb-Ta, i.e. the Kivu-Maniema tin-tantalum belt of eastern DRC. The reported latitude -26.0 lies in South Africa (Gauteng), outside DRC. Treated as a decimal-place slip (-26.0 -> -2.60); longitude 27.5E retained, which falls inside the Maniema/South Kivu tin belt. Precision about 1 degree; kept at source tier.

name: Koma Bangou
evidence: Koma Bangou gold field is in the Tillaberi region of western Niger; the reported point lies in Mali. A sign flip (17.0N 8.0E) would land in the Air massif, ~600 km from the real field, so automatic repair is suppressed and the record is dropped.

name: Koma Bangou
evidence: Same record as MRDS 10231853 (see above); dropped rather than auto-repaired.

name: Jiaodong
evidence: The Jiaodong gold province is in the Jiaodong peninsula, Shandong (Linglong 37.43N 120.44E, Jiaojia 37.38N 120.06E, Sanshandao 37.39N 119.95E). The reported point lies ~1,300 km WSW in southern Shaanxi. Relocated to the province centre (Zhaoyuan-Laizhou); precision about 0.3 degree. Found by the precious-gems group (0065) checking catalogue twins.

name: Kelian
evidence: Kelian (Rio Tinto, 1992-2005) is in Kutai Barat, East Kalimantan, near the equator; the reported point is Jakarta (Java). Relocated to about 0.05S 115.6E; precision about 0.3 degree (position from general knowledge, to verify).

name: Veladero
evidence: Veladero is in the high Andes of San Juan beside Pascua-Lama (29.37S 69.95W, Barrick); the reported longitude 66.88W lies in La Rioja ~300 km east. Same record id appears in Ag-specialist.geojson.

name: Pascua
evidence: Pascua (Chilean side of Pascua-Lama) is at 29.32S 70.03W on the Argentine border; the reported point is ~100 km west in the coastal ranges.

name: Berezovsk
evidence: Berezovsky (Berezovsk) gold field, Russia's first lode gold mine (1745), is ~12 km NE of Yekaterinburg (56.91N 60.81E); the reported latitude 57.85 is ~105 km north.
